card.name: Word-initial F in medical terms
card.fires_on: The letter F starting a medical term, mostly after a space or opening parenthesis, as in Fournier's Gangrene, Systemic Fibrosis and small foci. It also fires on a comma after a clause in one chemotherapy description.

modes.label: F in Fournier's
modes.description: The F that begins Fournier's gangrene inside a parenthesis after necrotizing fasciitis of the perineum.
modes.example: Necrotizing Fasciitis of the Perineum (<<F>>ournier's Gangrene

modes.label: F in fibrosis or foci
modes.description: A lone F that begins a word split into pieces, such as fibrosis in a boxed warning or foci in a scan description.
modes.example: NEPHROGENIC SYSTEMIC<< F>>IBROSIS Risk Associated with Intrathe

modes.label: Comma in chemotherapy text
modes.description: A comma after a clause about stopping tumor cell growth, seen only once.
modes.example: stop the growth of tumor cells<<,>> either by killing the cells or by stopping
